key: To tell you the truth, doc, the plants were terrifying.
en: To tell you the truth, doc, the plants were terrifying.
ja: 正直に言うとね　先生　あの植物たちは　恐ろしかったよ

key: But I was always more afraid of the people.
en: But I was always more afraid of the people.
ja: でも　いつも　もっと怖かったのは　人間のほうだった。

key: Did you know?
en: Did you know?
ja: 知ってた?

key: The best place to train your Attack stat is in a hidden playground in the slums!
en: The best place to train your Attack stat is in a hidden playground in the slums!
ja: 攻撃を　鍛えるのに　一番いい場所は　スラムに　隠れてる　遊び場だよ!

key: The best place to train your Attack stat is around the area where the slums used to be!
en: The best place to train your Attack stat is around the area where the slums used to be!
ja: 攻撃を　鍛えるのに　一番いい場所は　昔　スラムが　あったあたりだよ!

key: So, I understand that you've had some anxiety around this area after the attacks a bit ago.
en: So, I understand that you've had some anxiety around this area after the attacks a bit ago.
ja: それで　少し前の襲撃事件のあと　この辺りで　不安を　感じるように　なったんですね。

key: Could you tell me about that?
en: Could you tell me about that?
ja: それについて　話して　いただけますか?

key: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
en: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
ja: きっぷを　お求めですか? \ch[321,-1,グランドビュー駅,コガネ駅,アイビーライン駅,サンセット駅,ピオニー駅,キングスベリー駅,シャンティポート駅]

key: Excuse me, I'm a bit busy right now.
en: Excuse me, I'm a bit busy right now.
ja: すみません　いま　少し　立て込んでいまして。

key: I'm making preparations for this place to become a station for the rebuilt railnet system.
en: I'm making preparations for this place to become a station for the rebuilt railnet system.
ja: ここを　再建される鉄道網の　駅にするための　準備を　進めているんです。

key: We've also got people working just on the other side of Beryl Wall to run the tracks from Grandview Station up under the Jasper and Beryl Wards.
en: We've also got people working just on the other side of Beryl Wall to run the tracks from Grandview Station up under the Jasper and Beryl Wards.
ja: ベリルの壁の　向こう側でも　グランドビュー駅から　ジャスパー区と　ベリル区の下を通す　線路を　敷く作業を　進めている者たちが　います。

key: Of course, it's still going to take a lot more time and money for this project to be completed, so please be patient!
en: Of course, it's still going to take a lot more time and money for this project to be completed, so please be patient!
ja: もちろん　この計画が　完成するには　まだまだ　時間と　お金が　かかりますので　どうか　気長に　お待ちください!

key: EVE: This is the girl you told me about?
en: EVE: This is the girl you told me about?
ja: イヴ: あなたが　話していた子というのは　この子?

key: LASS: Oh, hi!
en: LASS: Oh, hi!
ja: ミニスカート: あ　こんにちは!

key: Are you the nurse?
en: Are you the nurse?
ja: 看護師さん?

key: EVE: I'm the doctor.
en: EVE: I'm the doctor.
ja: イヴ: 医者よ。

key: LASS: Oh!
en: LASS: Oh!
ja: ミニスカート: あら!

key: ...At your age?
en: ...At your age?
ja: ……その歳で?

key: EVE: It's in progress.
en: EVE: It's in progress.
ja: イヴ: 今　取得中なの。

key: But if you really want your problem fixed, I'm the best person for the job.
en: But if you really want your problem fixed, I'm the best person for the job.
ja: でも　本当に　その悩みを　治したいなら　わたしが　適任よ。

key: The clinic knows that too.
en: The clinic knows that too.
ja: クリニックも　それを　わかっているわ。

key: Now, how can I help you?
en: Now, how can I help you?
ja: さあ　どうしたの?

key: LASS: Er, so...
en: LASS: Er, so...
ja: ミニスカート: あの　えっと……

key: To get right to it, back when the lake was still pretty filthy, my Ducklett ran into it,
en: To get right to it, back when the lake was still pretty filthy, my Ducklett ran into it,
ja: はっきり言うと　湖が　まだ　かなり汚かった頃　うちのコアルヒーが　そこに　飛び込んじゃって

key: And when I tried to rescue him, I ended up falling in too.
en: And when I tried to rescue him, I ended up falling in too.
ja: それで　助けようとしたら　わたしまで　落ちちゃったの。

key: Just for a second! But I swallowed some of the murk, and,
en: Just for a second! But I swallowed some of the murk, and,
ja: ほんの一瞬だけど! でも　あの濁った水を　少し　飲んじゃって

key: Well, I've had a recurring cough since.
en: Well, I've had a recurring cough since.
ja: それから　ずっと　せきが　出たり　治ったり　してて。

key: It comes and goes, but...
en: It comes and goes, but...
ja: 出たり　止まったり　なんだけど……

key: My friends finally convinced me to see someone about it.
en: My friends finally convinced me to see someone about it.
ja: やっと　友達に　説得されて　誰かに　診てもらうことに　したの。

key: Do you know how hard it is to find a good Doctor in this region?
en: Do you know how hard it is to find a good Doctor in this region?
ja: この地方で　いい医者を　見つけるのが　どれだけ大変か　わかる?

key: And especially with the insurance situation!
en: And especially with the insurance situation!
ja: しかも　保険の状況が　あれじゃあね!

key: There was one guy who was offering off-market pharmaceuticals, but apparently he's gone now.
en: There was one guy who was offering off-market pharmaceuticals, but apparently he's gone now.
ja: 闇の薬を　売ってる人が　一人　いたんだけど　もう　いなくなっちゃったみたいで。

key: And every other search just turns up some old psychiatrist who went missing.
en: And every other search just turns up some old psychiatrist who went missing.
ja: 他に　探しても　行方不明の　老精神科医の話しか　出てこないし。

key: Anyway, I've been concerned, because my Ducklett--
en: Anyway, I've been concerned, because my Ducklett--
ja: とにかく　心配してたの　うちのコアルヒーが――

key: Huh???
en: Huh???

key: LASS: Hey, get-- come here!
en: LASS: Hey, get-- come here!
ja: ミニスカート: ちょっと　こら――　おいで!

key: EVE: ...
en: EVE: ...
ja: イヴ: ……

key: LASS: Just, sometimes he sounds a little hoarse too.
en: LASS: Just, sometimes he sounds a little hoarse too.
ja: ミニスカート: ただ　たまに　ちょっと　かすれた声に　なるの。

key: DUCKLETT: Ducc.
en: DUCKLETT: Ducc.
ja: コアルヒー: ダック。

key: EVE: Well, I'm sure we can do something.
en: EVE: Well, I'm sure we can do something.
ja: イヴ: そうね　何か　できることは　あるはずよ。

key: I'll have you both follow me upstairs.
en: I'll have you both follow me upstairs.
ja: 二人とも　上に　ついてきてもらえる?

key: Say, how does your Ducklett feel about Shaymin?
en: Say, how does your Ducklett feel about Shaymin?
ja: ところで　あなたのコアルヒー　シェイミは　平気?

key: LASS: Shaymin?!
en: LASS: Shaymin?!
ja: ミニスカート: シェイミ?!

key: You have one here?
en: You have one here?
ja: ここに　いるの?

key: EVE: No,
en: EVE: No,
ja: イヴ: いいえ

key: Not just one.
en: Not just one.
ja: 一体だけじゃないわ。
